## About

I am a Ph.D. candidate at **Shanghai Jiao Tong University**. My work centers on **forecasting**, **system modeling**, **quantitative analysis**, and **data-informed studies** for applied problems.

::: {.hero-lead}
I work across data analysis, system modeling, and practical evaluation, with an emphasis on reliable and interpretable workflows for real-world studies.
:::

## Research Highlights

::: {.card-list}
::: {.entry-card}
#### Quantitative Analysis and Evaluation
I study how predictive models, empirical structure, and numerical procedures can be combined to support careful application-level evaluation.
:::
::: {.entry-card}
#### Forecasting and Modeling
I build forecasting and system-modeling workflows that integrate data, domain understanding, and interpretable analysis.
:::
::: {.entry-card}
#### Reliable Applied Workflows
I design reusable workflows with staged checks, careful validation, and clear interfaces for recurring real-world studies.
:::
:::
